backlog.title: Scrape endpoint with HTML-to-text conversion
backlog.spec:
Add POST /v1/scrape that navigates to a URL and returns page content.

Files to modify:
- src/api.ts — add /v1/scrape route

Endpoint: POST /v1/scrape
  Body: { url: string, waitForSelector?: string, format?: 'html' | 'text' | 'markdown' }
  Response: { content: string, title: string, url: string }

Implementation:
  - Require active session (400 if none)
  - Connect to browser via puppeteer-core
  - Navigate to url, optionally wait for selector
  - Extract content based on format:
    - 'html': page.content()
    - 'text': page.evaluate(() => document.body.innerText)
    - 'markdown': same as text for now (markdown conversion is future)
  - Return { content, title, url }
  - Disconnect (don't close browser)

Pattern: follow existing /v1/actions/navigate structure in api.ts.
Do NOT add new dependencies.

log.description: Initial engine: launcher.ts (Chrome process management), session.ts (SessionManager), cdp-proxy.ts (WebSocket relay), api.ts (REST API with 7 endpoints + graceful shutdown)
Designed /v1/scrape endpoint — navigate + extract content in html/text/markdown format, wait for selector support
